requirements.statement: A merchant can sign up with its business details to start onboarding

criteria.must: A new merchant can submit business details (business name, email, country) to create a profile
A merchant profile starts with a not-submitted or pending KYC status until documents are submitted

requirements.statement: A merchant can submit KYC/verification documents for approval

criteria.must: A merchant can submit KYC documents (document type and document reference)
After submission the KYC status becomes pending, awaiting admin review

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can review and approve or reject a merchant's KYC submission

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can list pending KYC submissions
A Platform Admin can approve a KYC submission, setting the merchant's KYC status to approved
A Platform Admin can reject a KYC submission, setting the merchant's KYC status to rejected
A merchant cannot collect live payments until its KYC submission is approved

requirements.statement: A merchant can create a payment link for a specific amount and description

criteria.must: A merchant can create a payment link with an amount, currency and description
A newly created payment link starts in pending status

requirements.statement: A merchant can copy or share a payment link with a customer

criteria.must: The merchant can retrieve a shareable URL for a payment link

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment link using mobile money

criteria.must: A customer can open a payment link without signing in or creating an account
A customer can submit a mobile money payment (network and phone number) against a payment link

requirements.statement: A customer can pay a merchant's payment link using a card

criteria.must: A customer can submit a card payment against a payment link

requirements.statement: A customer sees clear confirmation of a payment's success or failure

criteria.must: After a successful payment the customer sees a success confirmation
After a failed payment the customer sees a failure message with a reason
The confirmation messaging is clear and actionable to a non-technical customer

requirements.statement: A merchant can see the live status of each payment link

criteria.must: A payment link's status reflects pending, paid, expired or failed accurately
A merchant can view the current status of any of its payment links

requirements.statement: A merchant can view a history of all its transactions

criteria.must: A merchant can list all transactions across its own payment links

requirements.statement: A merchant can link a bank account to receive payouts

criteria.must: A merchant can submit bank account details (bank name, account number, account name) to link an account

requirements.statement: A merchant receives payouts of its available balance to its linked bank account

criteria.must: The platform runs a payout automatically once per day for a merchant with an available balance
A completed payout reduces the merchant's available balance by the payout amount

requirements.statement: A merchant can view its payout history and current balance

criteria.must: A merchant can list its own past payouts with amount, bank account and status
A merchant can see its current available balance

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can view all merchants and their transaction and payout activity

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can list every merchant on the platform
A Platform Admin can list every transaction across all merchants
A Platform Admin can list every payout across all merchants

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can see and act on failed payouts or flagged transactions

criteria.must: A failed payout is visibly distinguishable from a completed one in the admin view
A Platform Admin can mark a failed payout as retried or resolved

requirements.statement: Merchants and Platform Admins sign in via SSO; customers never sign in

criteria.must: A merchant must sign in via SSO to access the merchant dashboard
A Platform Admin must sign in via SSO to access the admin console
A customer can complete a payment on a payment link without any sign-in step

requirements.statement: Merchants and customers are notified of payment outcomes by email

criteria.must: A customer receives an email notification of the payment outcome after paying a link
A merchant receives an email notification when a payment on one of its links completes
